items.question: In which month of 2025 was the average EU ETS allowance price highest? Give the month name.
items.text:
In 2025, the average EU ETS allowance price was highest in December.
ANSWER: Dec
sql: SELECT d.month_short FROM marts.fct_daily_carbon_price AS f JOIN marts.dim_date AS d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.month, d.month_short ORDER BY AVG(f.eua_price_eur_per_t) DESC LIMIT 1
